Parsing and finalizing ComputeBudgetProgram instructions for compute limits, fees, and data size.

# Purpose
This header defines the parser and finalizer for Solana `ComputeBudgetProgram` instructions in a transaction. It keeps per-transaction state in `fd_compute_budget_program_state_t`, tracks which compute budget instructions have already been seen, and rejects malformed input such as duplicate instructions, invalid sizes, or invalid heap frame values. The [`fd_compute_budget_program_parse`](<#fd_compute_budget_program_parse>) function reads each instruction and stores the requested compute unit limit, prioritization fee, heap size, or loaded account data size, while [`fd_compute_budget_program_finalize`](<#fd_compute_budget_program_finalize>) computes the final compute limit, loaded account data cost, and total priority fee for the transaction. The file also defines consensus-critical constants, including the program ID and limits used by the parser and fee calculation.
